label: CONNECTION

cover.headline: 4 things *long-term closeness* is built on
cover.sub: None of them is a grand gesture.

points.heading: Feeling known
points.body: Closeness grows when you keep learning each other, even after years together.
points.panel: “What’s something about you I might not know yet?”

points.heading: Feeling chosen
points.body: Small, everyday signs that you’d pick each other again.

points.heading: Feeling safe to speak
points.body: Honest words need a soft landing. How you respond shapes whether he tells you next time.
points.panel: “I’m glad you told me, even though it was hard to hear.”

points.heading: Your own steady ground
points.body: Feeling steady in yourself makes it easier to reach out without bracing for the answer.
points.panel: Do one thing this week that is just for you.

resource.name: The Devotion System
resource.covers: Guidance for confidence, communication, and long-term closeness.

caption:
Lasting closeness is less mysterious than it looks. It’s made of a few plain things, practiced over a long time.

If you’d like guidance on confidence, communication, and long-term closeness, there’s a resource for that at the link in bio. It’s a place to start, and no resource can promise how another person will respond.

Follow @spotseason for more small steps.
